applicabilityBasis.summary: YUSD is marketed as a 1:1 USD digital dollar and is integrated with wallets, exchanges, and card infrastructure, but it is BTC-backed, yield-bearing, and rewards holders through a delta-neutral funding strategy. Whether that synthetic yield product is a GENIUS payment stablecoin remains unresolved.

genius.notes: Aegis publicly describes YUSD as a BTC-backed, delta-neutral, yield-bearing digital dollar and says its offers are informational rather than a public offer. A legal issuer entity and domicile were not established from the public product materials reviewed. No public Aegis/YUSD GENIUS PPSI approval, official application, state-qualified pathway, or foreign-issuer exception registration was found as of 2026-08-14; GENIUS remains in proposed-rules phase.
